"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A typical family has saved $3,600 during President Obama's first term.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Obama is fighting to stop middle class families and those aspiring to join the middle class from seeing their taxes go up.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"There is a commitment to extend key tax relief for working families and those paying for college.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"There is a commitment to ask the wealthiest and corporations to pay their fair share.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party will vigorously oppose the type of tax reform supported by Mitt Romney.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Independent experts have found that Mitt Romney's tax reform would require raising taxes on typical families with children by at least $2,000 if it were paid for.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Mitt Romney's plan would cut taxes for those making over $3 million by an average of $250,000.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Mitt Romney's plan would create incentives that will lead to hundreds of thousands of jobs going overseas at the expense of American workers.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Accessible, affordable, high quality health care is part of the American promise.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Americans should have the security that comes with good health care.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"No one should go broke because they get sick.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Landmark health care reforms were enacted over the opposition of Republicans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The enacted health care reforms are already helping millions of Americans.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"More benefits from the health care reforms will come soon.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
